translation: Took place in posad Serock, 21 July 1890, in the first hour after noon. Appeared personally Berek Koltun, laborer, 65, and Icek Rubinsztejn, blacksmith, 49, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at three[?] in the morning in posad Serock died a child named Moszek Zylbersztejn, aged nine months, son of Judka and Rojza, [who had been] given out for upbringing to Cyrtla Wielkobrod[?]. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Moszek Zylbersztejn, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us. The witnesses declared themselves illiterate.
